fact_english: Banana ketchup was invented in the Philippines, and the food scientist María Orosa is credited with creating it.

lines.speaker: INDIO
lines.text: Ang banana ketchup, naimbento sa Pilipinas, at si María Orosa, food scientist, ang kinikilalang lumikha nito!
